shared.codeOrBackup: A code from your app, or a backup code
linked.title: Linked to {issuer}
linked.hint: You sign in with your {issuer} account. There's no password here.
linked.passwordLives: Your password and two-step sign-in live with {issuer}, so there's nothing to set up here.
linked.signOut: Signing out of {issuer} doesn't sign you out of {instance}. Devices shows where you're signed in.
linked.picture: Your name and picture here started from {issuer}, and they're yours to change.
password.changedHint: Every other device signed in to {instance} was signed out. This one stays signed in.
password.same: That's the password you have now.
password.range: {min} to {max} characters. Changing it signs out your other devices.
session.signOutHint: It stays in your list, so signing back in is one step.
session.removeHint: Signs out and takes {instance} off your server list here. Your account stays on the instance.
profile.nameEmpty: Your display name can't be empty.
profile.avatarLink: The avatar link needs to start with https://
profile.bannerLink: The banner link needs to start with https://
profile.pickName: Pick a name people will see.
profile.nameHint: What people see next to your messages.
profile.pronounsHint: Shown beside your username on your card.
profile.avatarHint: Drop a picture on it or pick one. GIFs keep moving. Without one you get your initial on your own color.
profile.bannerHint: A wide picture for the top of your card. Without one it's your profile color.
profile.colorHint: Colors your card's banner when there's no picture.
profile.effectHint: Plays over your card when people open it. Hovering the card plays it again.
profile.statusHint: Under your name in member lists, on every server here.
profile.usernameHint: Set when the account was made.
profile.colorAuto: Auto: fuwa picks from your account
effects.about.sakura: A gust of petals, then a gentle fall.
effects.about.starfall: Stars blink on around you, with the odd shooting star.
effects.about.sparkles: A pop of sparkles that keep glinting at the edges.
effects.about.bubbles: Bubbles pop in and float away.
effects.about.fireflies: Little lights that wander and glow.
effects.about.confetti: A burst of confetti for every visit.
serverProfiles.noServersHint: Once you join a server you can have a different name in it here.
serverProfiles.nicknameHint: Only in {server}. Leave it empty to go by {name}.
devices.onlyThisHint: Nothing else is signed in to your account on {instance}.
devices.signOutAllHint: They'll have to sign in again. This one stays signed in.
backup.title: Message backup
backup.offHint: A new device or browser starts with none of your earlier direct messages or secure channel messages. Back them up, locked with a recovery key that only you hold.
backup.lockedHint: Your account has a message backup. Enter its recovery key to read it on this device.
backup.lostAsk: Lost the key? Starting over deletes the backup, for every device, and backs up what this device has with a new key.
backup.onHint: What this device reads in direct messages and secure channels is backed up, encrypted with your recovery key.
backup.offAsk: Turn off message backup? It's deleted for every device. What each device keeps stays on it.
backup.newKeyAsk: Make a new recovery key? The backup starts over from what this device has, and the old key stops working.
backup.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it; select it and copy it yourself.
backup.fileNote: Keep this somewhere safe. Anyone with it and your account can read your backed-up messages; nobody can get it back for you if it's lost.
backup.saveHint: You'll need it to read your backup on a new device. It isn't kept anywhere but here, so if it's lost, nobody can get it back. Keep it in a password manager or somewhere only you can reach.
security.offHint: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password, so a leaked password alone can't get into your account on {instance}.
security.passwordHint: The one you sign in to {instance} with.
security.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app
security.scanHint: Any app that makes six-digit codes works, like 1Password, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator or Aegis.
security.openApp: Open in an app on this phone
security.typeCode: Type the code your app shows
security.typeCodeHint: It changes every 30 seconds; any current one works.
security.onSetupHint: Keep these somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if your phone isn't around.
security.qr: QR code for your authenticator app
security.codesFileTitle: Backup codes for your fuwa account on {instance}
security.onHint: Signing in to {instance} asks for a code from your authenticator app after your password.
security.codesLow: Make new ones before you run out.
security.codesEach: Each one signs you in once without your app.
security.oldCodes: Your old codes stopped working. Here are the new ones:
security.turnOffHint: Your password alone will be enough to sign in again.
serverNotifications.noServersHint: Once you join a server you can choose how it notifies you here.
serverNotifications.intro: These follow your account to every device. Anything on Default goes by this device's Notifications settings.
serverNotifications.mentionsDefault: This server's owners set Default to only @mentions for everyone. Pick All messages to hear about the rest.
serverNotifications.suppressHint: They won't count as mentions of you in this server.
serverNotifications.noChannels: Every channel follows the server. Add one to set it apart.
serverNotifications.muteServerHint: No sounds, notifications or unread badges from any of its channels.
serverNotifications.muteChannelHint: No sounds, notifications or unread badges.
agents.intro: Accounts your programs drive: bots, assistants, integrations. Each one signs in with a token and talks in the servers it's added to.
agents.adminsOnly: Only this instance's admins can make agents.
agents.notAllowed: This instance doesn't allow making agents.
agents.noneHint: Make one, give its token to your program, and add it to a server.
agents.howToApi: An agent uses the same API as the fuwa apps (gRPC, or gRPC-Web from a browser), with its token as a bearer token. It follows its servers with {subscribe} and talks with {send}.
agents.howToRules: Agents can't own servers or use direct messages, and they don't need to agree to a server's rules: whoever adds one answers for it.
agents.name: Name
agents.usernameRule: Usernames are 2 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, _ and ., like a person's. People add an agent to a server by it.
agents.copyNow: Copy the token now: it won't be shown again.
agents.tokenWarning: Anyone with it can act as the agent. Keep it with your program, never in a public repository.
agents.recentlyUsed: Used its token in the last few minutes
agents.publicHint: Anyone who manages a server can add it there. Off, only you can.
agents.noManaged: None yet: you need Manage server.
agents.deleteWarning: It leaves every server; its messages stay.
friends.serverFriendsHint: People in a server with you
friends.messagesEveryoneHint: Friends and people in a server with you
friends.unsupported: This instance runs a version of fuwa from before friends.
friends.requestsHint: Requests from anyone else never reach you; they're told you aren't taking them.
friends.messagesHint: Direct messages stay end-to-end encrypted whoever sends them.
friends.showOnlineHint: Friends see a green dot while you have fuwa open. Nobody else ever does.
friends.showMutualHint: On profiles, only when you, they and the friend you share all allow it.
privacy.deleteHint: Your account on {instance} goes for good: profile, settings and devices. Messages you sent stay in their servers, from "Deleted account".

privacy.owned.one: You own a server. Delete it first.
privacy.owned.other: You own {count} servers. Delete them first.

privacy.exportHint: Everything {instance} keeps about you, as one JSON file: your account, profile, settings, devices, servers, and every message you've sent.
privacy.dialogHint: This can't be undone. Once it's gone, {instance} leaves your list on this device too.
privacy.lineProfile: Your profile, settings and devices are deleted.
privacy.lineServers: You leave every server you're in.
privacy.activityHint: Games and apps the desktop app sees, shown to people who share a server with you. Nothing is kept: it's gone when you stop.
privacy.activityOff: {instance} doesn't show what people are doing. Your status still shows.
signIn.onlyWay: This is your only way in, so it stays until you add another.
signIn.add: Add a way to sign in
signIn.addNote: This instance keeps only your account's id there and its name. Your devices show a notice when a way in is added.
signIn.freshNote: For your safety, sign out and back in first, then try again within 10 minutes.
decorations.label: Avatar decoration
decorations.hint: A picture around your avatar, wherever it shows on this instance. These are the ones it offers.
serverProfiles.effectHint: Plays on your card in this server instead of your profile's effect. The server may offer its own.
serverProfiles.decorationHint: Shows around your avatar in this server instead of your profile's.
